brief:
The Palestinian Health Ministry said the number of Palestinians killed in the occupied West Bank has reached 100 since the start of 2026, Shehab Wire reported. Four Palestinians were shot dead by Israeli occupation forces in the past 24 hours, according to the ministry's announcement, pushing the cumulative toll past the symbolic threshold early in the calendar year.

The latest deaths mark a continuation of violence in the territory. The ministry's statement did not specify the circumstances surrounding each killing or provide a geographic breakdown of where the fatalities occurred across the West Bank's various districts and cities.
